audience: Technically minded men roughly 25-50 who care about hormones, fertility, sexual function, appearance, performance, diagnostics and longevity; skeptical of generic wellness advice and bro-science.
editorial_promise: Biotica Media investigates the science, technology, incentives and bullshit shaping men's health.

pillars.name: Testosterone & Hormonal Optimization
pillars.audience_job: Help viewers understand what hormone numbers mean, what changes them, and what tradeoffs treatment creates.

pillars.name: Male Fertility & Reproductive Health
pillars.audience_job: Explain fertility risks, testing, treatment and preservation before decisions become irreversible.
avoid: unsupported causal claims about environmental exposures

pillars.name: Sexual Function & Urology
pillars.audience_job: Turn embarrassing or confusing symptoms into understandable mechanisms, options and questions to ask.

pillars.name: Health-Maxxing: What Actually Works?
pillars.audience_job: Separate useful optimization from expensive, weakly supported or over-marketed interventions.

pillars.name: Men's Health Conspiracy Files
pillars.audience_job: Investigate claims that something is being hidden, distorted or economically incentivized without assuming the conspiracy is true.
topic_examples: why cheap treatments receive less attention
avoid: letting a sponsor influence the verdict

pillars.name: Frontier Men's Health Tech
pillars.audience_job: Show viewers what is coming next in diagnostics, devices, drugs, AI and reproductive technology and what evidence actually exists.
avoid: treating patents as proof of efficacy
equating early trials with clinical validation
